sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Minerals Sector Governance Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXI OF 2017
ACT XXI OF 2017
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA MINERALS SECTOR
GOVERNANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Minerals
Sector Governance Act, 2016
WHEREAS
it is expedient to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Minerals Sector Governance Act,
2016 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. I of 2017) for the purposes hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Minerals Sector Governance (Amendment)
Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
